pageTitle: BEST HOMEOPATHIC TREATMENT AVAILABLE FOR VARIOUS DISORDERS

pageIntro.original: Homeopathy is a medical system based on the belief that the body can cure itself. Those who practice it use tiny amounts of natural substances, like plants and minerals. They believe these stimulate the healing process.
